error_postmortems.event: Telegram HTML Parsing Error on <15 min badge
error_postmortems.root_cause: Unescaped '<15' in badge text triggered Telegram unsupported start tag error.
error_postmortems.fix_applied: Wrap all badge, header, and body text in escapeHtml() before JSON POST.

error_postmortems.event: QA Review Rejection (Gumroad & Stripe Sales to Airtable Clean Accounting Sync)
error_postmortems.root_cause: The workflow fails to account for structural data wrapper discrepancies between Gumroad and Stripe payloads (e.g., Gumroad JSON often lacks the root body wrapper depending on configuration, while Stripe wraps event objects in data.object). Furthermore, the Slack node expression uses {{$json.body.email}} after the Airtable node, which changes the execution context and will result in undefined data evaluation.
error_postmortems.fix_applied: Aborted commit and logged feedback for future revision.
